dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-visibility, single thick white band across the greater coverts exhibiting strong grayscale contrast against the dark gray wing plumage.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and prominent pale edges creating distinct linear boundaries along the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: High-contrast white patch of roughly oval geometry located centrally on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, distinct non-linear boundary where the black crown meets the white nape patch, which then transitions into the gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white cheek patch and a black ventral stripe visible on the lower lateral region.
